fusions.name: Burrow Burst
fusions.desc: Tunnels you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then erupts, dealing 12 earth damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Scree
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. Strikes from the ground beneath it for 24 rock damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Sandfish Dive
fusions.desc: Dives under the ground and surfaces 5 tiles ahead. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Sunned on Slate
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
